secret.token-shape.fix: Remove the value. Name where the credential lives instead (e.g. `LLM_API_KEY` supplied out of band) — a committed or published token is a durable leak.

secret.labeled-assignment.message: {where} assigns a value to the secret-labelled variable `{label}`
secret.labeled-assignment.fix: Replace the value with a placeholder such as `<supplied out of band>` unless it is certainly not a secret.

issue.title.missing.fix: Set `title` in the draft's front matter.

issue.title.too-long.message: the title is {length} characters; GitHub allows at most {max}
issue.title.too-long.fix: Shorten the title; the detail belongs in the body.

issue.body.preamble-missing.message: the body does not open with a preamble paragraph before the first section
issue.body.preamble-missing.fix: Start the body with one paragraph stating what the issue delivers and why it matters now.

issue.body.section-duplicate.fix: Merge the duplicate sections into one.

issue.body.section-empty.fix: Write the section's content or remove an optional section.

issue.body.unknown-section.message: `## {section}` is not a section of the issue structure
issue.body.unknown-section.fix: Use the required sections ({order}) and the optional ones ({optional}); use `###` for sub-headings.

issue.body.engine-marker.message: the body carries the engine-owned marker `{marker}`
issue.body.engine-marker.fix: Remove it. The only engine marker an author may write is `SE_DEPENDS_ON_ISSUES`; the engine writes every other marker itself.

issue.body.platform-marker.message: the body carries the AgentLoom card marker (`agentloom-card:`)
issue.body.platform-marker.fix: Remove it. The card marker belongs to issues the platform opens from a dashboard card.

issue.depends-on.duplicate-marker.fix: Merge them into one marker; the engine keeps only the last one it finds.

issue.depends-on.malformed.message: the `SE_DEPENDS_ON_ISSUES` marker does not list issue numbers
issue.depends-on.malformed.fix: Write it as `<!-- SE_DEPENDS_ON_ISSUES: 412, 415 -->` with real issue numbers.

issue.depends-on.in-batch-item.message: a batch item body carries a `SE_DEPENDS_ON_ISSUES` marker
issue.depends-on.in-batch-item.fix: Declare the edge in the item's `depends_on`; the marker is rendered with real numbers when the issue is opened.

issue.tech-skills.unknown-id.message: `{id}` is not in the engine's tech-skill pool
issue.tech-skills.unknown-id.fix: Use only ids from `references/tech-skills.json`, or omit the section.

issue.tech-skills.role-key.message: `{id}` is an org-chart role key, not a tech skill
issue.tech-skills.role-key.fix: Assign roles with `se:resolve-worker:<role>` labels; `## Tech Skills` lists pool ids only.

issue.tech-skills.malformed.message: a `## Tech Skills` line is not a list item naming one backticked id
issue.tech-skills.malformed.fix: Write each entry as ``- `playwright-cli` `` on its own line.

issue.tech-skills.empty-section.message: `## Tech Skills` is present but lists no skills
issue.tech-skills.empty-section.fix: Omit the section when no pool skill applies.

issue.substance.observed-failure-missing.message: a `{type}` issue has no `### Observed failure` under Background
issue.substance.observed-failure-missing.fix: Record what was observed and where (failing test, log line, screenshot) under `### Observed failure`.

issue.substance.no-code-reference.message: a `{type}` issue cites no repository file with a line number
issue.substance.no-code-reference.fix: Ground the root cause in the code: cite the verified call chain as `path/to/file.ext:42`.

issue.substance.path-not-found.message: `{path}` is cited but does not exist in this checkout
issue.substance.path-not-found.fix: Cite a path you verified in the checkout.

issue.substance.section-thin.message: `## {section}` has {length} characters of content; the floor is {min}
issue.substance.section-thin.fix: Write the section so a resolver can act without rediscovering the context.

issue.substance.acceptance-not-checklist.message: `## Acceptance Criteria` has no checklist items
issue.substance.acceptance-not-checklist.fix: Write each criterion as a testable `- [ ] …` item.

issue.substance.unachievable-criterion.message: an acceptance criterion requires {needs}, which no single resolver round can do
issue.substance.unachievable-criterion.fix: A round makes one commit and one push and is judged on the final head. Write the proof as a test, or offer an alternative the resolver can satisfy ("or an equivalent documented check"), and move a check that genuinely needs an operator to `## Manual Verification`.

issue.substance.meta-narration.message: the body contains meta narration or deferred investigation (`{phrase}`)
issue.substance.meta-narration.fix: State findings and the proposed change; do the investigation before filing.

issue.labels.marker-missing.fix: Add `{label}`; the engine selects only issues that carry it.

issue.labels.type-invalid.message: `{label}` is not a valid issue type

issue.labels.resolve-worker-missing.fix: Add one or two resolver roles from `.seed-engine/org-chart.yml`, primary role first.

issue.labels.resolve-worker-too-many.fix: Keep role assignment conservative: the primary role, plus one more only when the work truly spans both.

issue.labels.unknown-role.message: `{role}` is not a role key in `.seed-engine/org-chart.yml`
issue.labels.unknown-role.fix: Use a `roles[].key` from the repository's org chart.

issue.labels.lifecycle.fix: Remove it. The engine applies lifecycle labels itself; a hand-applied one makes it skip or misread the issue.

issue.labels.unexpected.message: `{label}` is not part of the `{root}:` authoring scheme
issue.labels.unexpected.fix: Remove it. Authors write the marker, type, priority and resolve-worker labels (plus `{root}:parked` / `{root}:pinned`).

issue.labels.provenance-missing.fix: Add `{label}` so AgentLoom can tell agent-authored work apart.

issue.provenance.marker-missing.message: the hidden origin marker is missing

issue.provenance.marker-malformed.fix: Write exactly `{marker}`, or `{marker_with_user}` when connected to AgentLoom.

issue.provenance.requested-by-not-uuid.message: `requested-by` is not an AgentLoom user uuid
issue.provenance.requested-by-not-uuid.fix: Use the uuid AgentLoom returns for your user, or drop the `requested-by` part. Never an email or login.

issue.duplicate.open-issue.message: open issue #{number} looks like the same work: {title}
issue.duplicate.open-issue.fix: Read it first. Extend it with a comment, or say why this is different work.

issue.duplicate.roadmap-item.message: roadmap item `{id}` looks like the same work
issue.duplicate.roadmap-item.fix: Read it first; if it is already planned, say so instead of filing over it.

batch.empty.fix: Put one issue draft per file in the batch directory.

batch.ref.invalid.fix: Use a short slug such as `api-schema` or `step-1` (letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-`; at most 64).

batch.ref.duplicate.message: ref `{ref}` is used by more than one item
batch.ref.duplicate.fix: Give every item its own ref.

batch.depends-on.invalid.message: a `depends_on` entry is neither a sibling ref nor a positive issue number
batch.depends-on.invalid.fix: List sibling refs, or the real numbers of issues that already exist in this repository.

batch.depends-on.unknown-ref.fix: Name a ref defined in this batch, or the real number of an existing issue.

batch.depends-on.cycle.fix: Dependencies must run one way; break the cycle.

roadmap.item.removed.fix: Restore it. Settle obsolete work through AgentLoom so the lifecycle record stays intact.

roadmap.id.invalid.message: `{id}` is not a lowercase slug id
roadmap.id.invalid.fix: Use lowercase letters and digits separated by `-` or `.` (e.g. `fleet-wide-vehicle-list`), at most {max} characters.

roadmap.id.duplicate.message: id `{id}` appears {count} times in the roadmap
roadmap.id.duplicate.fix: Ids are unique across all versions; the engine silently skips a duplicate.

roadmap.field.unknown.message: `{field}` is not a roadmap task field

roadmap.version.current-missing.message: `current_version` does not name a version of the roadmap
roadmap.version.current-missing.fix: Set `current_version` to a version id before adding tasks.

roadmap.version.maintenance-invalid.message: `maintenance_versions` is not a list of version ids
roadmap.version.maintenance-invalid.fix: Write `maintenance_versions: [v1.1, …]`, or `[]`; the generator reads anything else as no maintenance versions.

roadmap.add.inactive-version.message: new item `{id}` is in version `{version}`, which is not active
roadmap.add.inactive-version.fix: Add new tasks under `current_version` (`{current}`) or a version listed in `maintenance_versions`; the generator never schedules items anywhere else.

roadmap.add.status.fix: Set `status: {status}`; every other status is written by the engine.

roadmap.engine-field.authored.message: new item `{id}` carries the engine-owned field `{field}`
roadmap.engine-field.authored.fix: Remove it; the engine writes it.

roadmap.engine-field.changed.fix: Revert it; the engine owns the lifecycle.

roadmap.patch.not-planned.message: `{id}` is `{status}`; only `{planned}` items may be edited
roadmap.patch.not-planned.fix: An item past planning has an issue frozen against it — file a follow-up issue or steer the run instead.

roadmap.description.missing.fix: Write what the task delivers and why, grounded in the repository.

roadmap.description.too-long.message: the description of `{id}` is {length} characters, over its {budget}-character budget
roadmap.description.too-long.fix: Tighten it to at most {budget} characters; the generator expands the intent into the issue.

roadmap.description.issue-section.message: the description of `{id}` carries the issue heading `{heading}`
roadmap.description.issue-section.fix: A roadmap task is prose intent; the generator writes Scope, Implementation Notes and Acceptance Criteria.

roadmap.description.checklist.message: the description of `{id}` carries checklist items
roadmap.description.checklist.fix: Acceptance criteria belong to the generated issue, not the roadmap task.

roadmap.dependencies.invalid.message: `dependencies` of `{id}` is not a list of roadmap ids

roadmap.dependencies.unresolved.message: `{id}` depends on `{dep}`, which is not a roadmap item
roadmap.dependencies.unresolved.fix: Name an existing item or one added in this change.

roadmap.dependencies.cycle.fix: Dependencies must run one way; break the cycle.

roadmap.dependencies.prose-only.message: the description of `{id}` names roadmap item `{dep}` but `dependencies` does not list it
roadmap.dependencies.prose-only.fix: If the task must wait for `{dep}`, add it to `dependencies`; the generator reads only the structured field.

roadmap.parent-id.unresolved.message: `parent_id` of `{id}` names `{parent}`, which is not a roadmap item
roadmap.parent-id.unresolved.fix: Name an existing item or one added in this change.

roadmap.tech-skills.invalid.message: `tech_skills` of `{id}` is not a list of pool ids

roadmap.tech-skills.unknown-id.message: `{skill}` on `{id}` is not in the engine's tech-skill pool
roadmap.tech-skills.unknown-id.fix: Use only ids from `references/tech-skills.json`; `[]` is the default.

roadmap.tech-skills.role-key.message: `{skill}` on `{id}` is an org-chart role key, not a tech skill
roadmap.tech-skills.role-key.fix: Role skills are silently invalid as `tech_skills`; use pool ids only.

roadmap.scheduling.invalid.fix: Use `pinned` or `parked`; remove the key to clear it (an explicit null is malformed).

roadmap.tags.invalid.message: `tags` of `{id}` is not a list of strings
roadmap.tags.invalid.fix: Run `roadmap-tag.py` to stamp the provenance tags.

roadmap.tags.not-provenance.message: `{tag}` on `{id}` is not a provenance tag
roadmap.tags.not-provenance.fix: Authors write only `{user_generated}` and `{requested_by}<uuid>`; other tags are operator-owned.

roadmap.tags.requested-by-not-uuid.message: `{tag}` on `{id}` does not carry a user uuid
roadmap.tags.requested-by-not-uuid.fix: Use the AgentLoom user uuid, or omit the tag offline. Never an email or login: the roadmap is committed history.

roadmap.tags.changed.message: the tags of existing item `{id}` changed
roadmap.tags.changed.fix: Revert them; tags on existing items are operator-owned.

roadmap.docs.invalid.message: `docs` of `{id}` is not a list of repository paths

roadmap.docs.not-found.message: `{path}` in `docs` of `{id}` does not exist in this checkout
roadmap.docs.not-found.fix: Point at a document that exists.

roadmap.manual-blocker.invalid.fix: Write `{ id: BLK-…, title, kind: operator_action | upstream_request | other, doc }` (plus `recipient` for an upstream_request).

blocker.not-found.message: `{id}` is not in the blocker registry

blocker.new-entry.message: `{id}` is not in the base registry
blocker.new-entry.fix: A completion edits an existing entry; new planning blockers are authored with their roadmap task.

blocker.resolver-origin.fix: Resolver blockers are answered on the run (Record answers & resume), never by editing the registry.

blocker.unchanged.fix: Nothing to validate; record the resolution with `blocker-complete.py`.

blocker.status.invalid.message: `{status}` is not a valid status for a `{kind}` blocker

blocker.status.unchanged.message: `{id}` stays `{status}`: this edits the recorded entry rather than completing it
blocker.status.unchanged.fix: Keep it to a correction of the resolution text. A completion moves the status forward with `blocker-complete.py`.

blocker.resolution.required.fix: Summarise what was decided or completed, without secret values.

blocker.resolution.secret-assignment.message: `resolution_summary` assigns a value to the secret-labelled variable `{label}`
blocker.resolution.secret-assignment.fix: Replace the value with where it lives, or confirm it is not a secret by passing `--ack {label}`.

blocker.resolved.invalid.message: `resolved` of `{id}` is not an ISO date

blocker.field.changed.fix: A completion writes only {fields}; revert the other edits.

blocker.registry.other-entries.fix: Complete one blocker per edit; revert the other entries.

shapes.needs: a throwaway, temporary or reverted commit
a deliberately red or failing run
an observation in production, staging or a deployed environment
